title: HelioField: the Sun's coronal magnetic field in 3D
description:
HelioField is a web tool that shows the Sun's coronal magnetic field in 3D for any date since May 2010. It draws potential-field source-surface (PFSS) field lines from NSO/GONG and SDO/HMI magnetograms, the source surface and its neutral line, the heliospheric current sheet wound into a Parker spiral, and the magnetic connection of planets and spacecraft (Parker Solar Probe, Solar Orbiter, STEREO, BepiColombo and the L1 fleet) through ballistic Parker spirals and PFSS field lines down to the photosphere. Open field lines can be extended into the heliosphere. Recent days are computed nightly from GONG maps; any other date is solved in the browser from SDO/HMI Carrington-rotation synoptic maps with a spherical-harmonic PFSS solver validated against sunkit-magex. The page offers dark and light themes with an accessibility-checked colour scheme, PNG and PDF snapshots, shareable links and an embeddable mode.

Live site: https://sr-dash.github.io/heliofield/
